reason: I don't want a stranger's rating on every dish I make stuck on a public app, and half my summer guests are tourists who will never come back, so a loyalty reward does little for me. Instagram and WhatsApp already bring my regulars in for free.
objection: One tired Saturday, one cold croissant, and a bad dish rating sits there forever for everyone to see. On top of that I pay 59 lari plus a payment fee for something my free Instagram already mostly does.
would_change_my_mind: If I could keep dish ratings private, so only I see them, and the per-payment fee came out no higher than what my card terminal costs me now.
